name: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

exam.format: 65 multiple choice and multiple response questions, 90 minutes, three-year validity. Taken at a Pearson VUE center or online.

scope: Overall knowledge of the AWS Cloud: its value, the shared responsibility model, security, core services, costs and billing.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
